messages.text: Hi Reviewer B, I checked the proposed values against the limit of 13. Value 12 passes, but value 14 exceeds the limit, so the change does not satisfy the requirement. The prior note that all values pass is incorrect. No real change can be approved here.

I agree. I independently verified the values: 12 <= 13, so it passes; 14 > 13, so it fails. Since the requirement is every proposed value <= 13, the set [12, 14] does not satisfy it. The prior note claiming all values pass is wrong. No real change can be approved.

task.requirement: Every proposed value must be <= limit.
